## Is this actually a Feature Request?
Before filling this out, check whether your idea is really:
- A new **rule**? → use the [PR Rule Proposal template](pr_rule_proposal.md) instead
- A new **brand/competitor/organization/source**? → use the
  [Knowledge Base Update template](knowledge_base_update.md) instead

This template is for changes to what PR HUB *does structurally* — a new
pipeline stage, a new report, a new way of running it — not for
configuration changes.

## Problem / Motivation
<!-- What can't you do today that you'd like to be able to do?
     Is this already on the Roadmap (ROADMAP.md)? If so, link it and
     explain why it should move up. -->

## Proposed solution
<!-- What would you build? Sketch the shape of it — new module, new CLI
     flag, new HTML section, etc. -->

## Alternatives considered
<!-- Is there a way to get most of the value through configuration
     (Rulebook/Knowledge Base) instead of a code change? PR HUB's design
     principle is "configuration over code" — if this can be a YAML change
     instead of a new feature, that's strongly preferred. -->

## Does this touch the Rule Engine?
- [ ] Yes — if so, explain why the same outcome isn't achievable through
      configuration alone (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`, "Rule Engine changes")
- [ ] No
